row.statement_caveat: Use outer boundary liminf in the standard definition; the source's displayed halfspace formula has an S/H notational mismatch. Thin-shell and slicing results are separate and reported resolved by this source.

row.independent_check: The constant is attained by any nonconstant linear function, checking both normalization and dimension independence.
row.method: Gaussian special case by orthogonal expansion
row.obstruction: A general isotropic log-concave measure lacks this diagonal Hermite generator. This special case does not prove its uniform Poincare or Cheeger bound.
row.result: For standard Gaussian measure, expand a polynomial f in orthonormal multivariate Hermite polynomials with coefficients a_alpha. Then Var(f)=sum_(|alpha|>=1) a_alpha^2 <= sum |alpha| a_alpha^2 = E||gradient f||^2. Closure in Gaussian Sobolev norm extends the inequality to its natural domain.
